data.one_liner: A CI quality gate for Flutter localization testing across locales, viewports, and scales.
data.what_it_does: Runs app flows across multiple locales, text scales, device sizes, and RTL modes to report broken layouts, missing keys, and text overflows with screenshot proof.
use_when: You want to automate localization QA and catch text overflows before shipping.
You need to test your app across different locales, text scales, and RTL layouts automatically.
avoid_when: You are not using localization in your Flutter app.
You do not write widget or integration tests.
strengths: Tests multiple variants (locales, scales, viewports, dark mode) from a single test call.
Catches text overflows, missing ARB keys, and placeholder mismatches.
Provides screenshot diffing and regression reports.
weaknesses: Relies on golden tests and screenshot comparisons, which can be brittle across different host operating systems.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency as a dev_dependency, write a sweep test calling sweepTest, and generate initial golden baselines using dart run locale_sweep update.
